params.body:
A switch *Nieuws tonen* in the site settings (Hoet only), off by default.

On, the site shows *Nieuws* in the main menu and the footer, and the three newest articles on the home above the production film. Off, articles still live at their own address (for a direct link or a newsletter), but nothing on the site points to them yet. This lets the blog fill up with a handful of articles before it goes in the menu. The site also hides *Nieuws* while there is no listed article, switch or not.

Read by hoet-eyewear (`App\Support\Journal::enabled`), proposed alongside. Either can merge first: without the field the site treats it as off.

`tsc --noEmit`, `sanity schema validate` (0 errors, 0 warnings), offline vitest 62/62. After merge: `npm run deploy`.
params.title: Add a switch for Nieuws on the site
